name: Open a PR and ship it
description: A person opens the pull request, gets it reviewed and releases it, then records the PR URL and notes for the retro (inputs "url" and "went-well").

parameters.label: Where the work's documents are
parameters.description: The directory the earlier steps saved their documents in, e.g. {{scratch.dir}} for feature-flow.

parameters.label: How to release it
parameters.description: Where the release plan is, or how this repo releases.

step.name: Open a PR and ship it
step.instructions: Open a pull request for {{ticket.key}} that links {{ticket.url}} and the documents in {{params.docs}}/, get it reviewed, and release it following {{params.release}}.

inputs.label: Pull request URL
inputs.help: Recorded on the run so it links to the PR.

inputs.label: Anything the retro should know (what went well or badly)?
